verdict.rationale: Exit paths are only implied. TruffleHog has an open-source CLI with a self-hosted deployment option (trufflehog-docs-22, trufflehog-docs-28, trufflehog-probe-4), and findings can be routed out to Slack, Jira, email or webhooks (trufflehog-docs-11). However, no evidence documents a bulk export of findings or account data in open formats. Missing for 10: documented full data export from the web UI/Enterprise, open export formats (e.g., JSON/CSV), offboarding/migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
